record_title: Flat s-number and strict-singularity profiles of relative Toeplitz Schur multipliers
provenance: A finite near-norm matrix block is replicated by simultaneous right translations into infinitely many disjoint row/column blocks. Schatten block-sum identities give an exact l_p (or c0) witness on which the multiplier is a scalar multiple of an isometry; escaping rectangular compressions yield the Kolmogorov and Hausdorff-noncompactness equalities.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The claimed contribution is the exact flat approximation/Gelfand/Kolmogorov/Bernstein profile, norm distance to compact/FSS/SS classes, and maximal noncompactness for bounded relative Toeplitz Schur multipliers on Banach Schatten classes. Hladnik (2000) was not fully inspected; broad older Schur-multiplier and s-number literature may contain an equivalent differently phrased consequence. The theorem excludes finite groups, arbitrary Schur symbols, and 0<p<1.
